name: Siam Future Development Public Company Limited
summary: Siam Future Development Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the rental of building space and provision of utility services in Thailand. It is involved in the development and management of shopping centers; and installation of electricity and water meters. As of December 31, 2020, the company operated 18 centers with gross leasable area of approximately 430,628 square meters. It also provides utility services that comprise electricity, gas, water supply, and telephone services; and location procurement services. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
